primary_configuration: tgn/context, all three seeds; not selected by test performance
primary_comparator: published Granomaly TGN under the common protocol, context input
primary_operating_point: Threshold from normal calibration only, target FPR 0.1%; report actual test FPR as well as recall
report_all: Every model, both feature sets, all registered seeds, every target capture, failures and budget violations. No rules and no comparison to published percentages from other datasets.
initialization_uncertainty: Mean, standard deviation and range over three seeds, with KitNET single deterministic author seed explicitly identified
data_uncertainty: Per-record conditional 512-request block bootstrap on fixed-score predictions; no claims about independent deployments
test_size: Unique eligible requests counted once across clean holdout and all target captures; exclude unknown labels only from labelled metrics, not prediction arrays. Training repeats and bootstrap draws never increase sample counts.
claim_scope: Direct common-protocol ML component benchmark and feature ablation. Existing dataset limitations remain; results cannot establish the full CU/witness integrity method or superiority on unobserved semantic attacks.
